svg.title: Figure 3-15. SW FMEA reaction time by defence layer
svg.desc: SW FMEA (SWF rev 1.13): reaction times of 11 of 139 safety mechanisms on 10 failure modes, by defence layer (host, envelope, alert, siren, vehicle), on a log time axis; 11 code-derived. 8 rows have no timed warning to the driver.
svg.text: Figure 3-15 · SW FMEA — who catches it, and when
SWF rev 1.13 · BL-007 · draft · after a fault starts, how long until each layer reacts, and whether the driver is told
11 of 139 safety mechanisms carry a reaction time, on 10 failure modes; 11 code-derived. 8 of those 10 have no timed warning to the driver.

rect.title: SWF-018 · envelope 90 ms (code-derived): IWDG window watchdog resets the MCU within about 90 ms; reset releases the relay [panda/board/drivers/hw_watchdog.h:21 (90 ms at 32 kHz LSI)]

svg.text: Heartbeat reports engaged while no fresh command reaches…

rect.title: SWF-020 · envelope 50 ms (code-derived): BL-005, reference build: when no STEERING_LKA arrives for 50 ms (ACC_CONTROL 100 ms) the panda revokes authority whatever the heartbeat says (TSR-408, SWF-014.C2). It covers the "none arrive" branch only; frames that keep arriving with a stale value are not detected [opendbc_repo/opendbc/safety/modes/toyota.h (TX arrival, STEERING_LKA 50 ms; TSR-408)]

svg.text: Heartbeat gap longer than the 0.3 s panda budget while…

circle.title: SWF-021 · host 500 ms (code-derived): selfdrived controlsMismatch (IMMEDIATE_DISABLE, QM) after 2 consecutive pandaStates samples with controlsAllowed false, and at most 0.5 s after the first mismatched frame (supervision.py ControlsMismatch, TSR-621, #51; 200 cumulative frames at BL-004). pandaHeartbeatLost (immediate disable) on pandaState.heartbeatLost (TSR-615). Both need pandaStates to keep arriving [openpilot/selfdrive/selfdrived/selfdrived.py:361-375 (controlsMismatch; TSR-621)]

path.title: SWF-021 · siren 560 ms (code-derived): Panda siren for 3 s when the 0.3 s revocation removes granted authority, about 0.56 s after the last heartbeat (panda c33343b, all builds; WP-S-04 T-07a); host unit test panda/tests/heartbeat_siren in CI, not on target. Independent of the SoC [panda/board/main.c:236-256; WP-S-04 T-07a]

svg.text: Each row is a failure mode with at least one safety mechanism that records `reaction_s`; each mark is one mechanism at the time from the fault to its layer's reaction. Hover a mark for the mechanism and where its time comes from.
Filled marks are read from the code (code-derived) or measured; hollow marks are a requirement budget or an estimate. No time here is measured, and the figure does not check any time against an FTTI.
"None timed" means no alert or siren mechanism on that row records a time; the driver may still be warned by an untimed mechanism listed in the YAML.
